More qualified conversations. More pipeline coverage. Less dependence on any single lead source.

Common questions

Everything you need to know before putting your pipeline in motion.

Do you guarantee sales-qualified leads?

Yes. We agree on your sales-qualified lead criteria before the campaign begins. If the leads we deliver don’t meet the agreed criteria, we continue working at no additional cost. 

How quickly can a campaign go live?

Most campaigns are live within 15 business days of kickoff. This includes ICP definition, target account research, messaging and call-script development, domain warming, inbox setup, and launch QA. There is no cost for the Onboarding. 

What does MarketJoy actually manage?

MarketJoy provides an end-to-end demand generation team. We handle strategy, data, messaging, outbound email and calling, campaign execution, buyer-intent intelligence, AI Search visibility, reporting, and ongoing optimization. 

Do you charge setup fees?

No. There are no setup fees. Onboarding, ICP development, messaging, campaign setup, script development, domain warming, and launch preparation are included. 

Do you work with companies outside the USA?

Yes. MarketJoy is GDPR and CASL compliant and works with B2B companies across the USA, Canada, and the UK. 

How is MarketJoy different from other lead generation companies?

Most lead generation providers focus on a single channel or simply deliver lists and activity. MarketJoy combines strategy, data, messaging, human outbound execution, buyer-intent intelligence, and AI Search visibility to build a more diversified pipeline. 

The goal isn’t simply to generate activity. It’s to create qualified sales opportunities and make your pipeline less dependent on any one source.

Do you only provide outbound lead generation?

No. MarketJoy combines proven outbound with AI Search visibility and buyer-intent intelligence. This allows us to create a more diversified pipeline with multiple sources of sales opportunities rather than relying on one channel. 

How does InfoJoy GTM help my campaign?

InfoJoy GTM helps identify companies showing buying signals, the right contacts within those companies, and when there is a reason to engage. It gives MarketJoy additional intelligence to prioritize accounts and personalize both email and call outreach. 

How does AI Search fit into lead generation?

Buyers are increasingly using AI Search to research companies and solutions before speaking with sales. MarketJoy helps improve your visibility across AI Search, so your company has a better opportunity of being discovered before your competitors. 

Who is MarketJoy a good fit for?

MarketJoy is designed for B2B companies that need a more consistent flow of qualified sales opportunities and don’t want their pipeline dependent on a single lead source. We work particularly well with companies that have a defined offering, identifiable target market, and sales team ready to follow up on qualified opportunities. 

What happens while onboarding?

Your dedicated MarketJoy team defines your ICP, researches target accounts and contacts, develops custom email and call playbooks, identifies relevant buying signals, sets up and warms your domains, and completes a multi-point launch QA before the campaign goes live. 

What happens after I request a strategy call?

A member of our growth team will review your business, target market, sales goals, and current lead sources. We’ll then discuss where MarketJoy may be able to create an additional pipeline and what a potential program could look like. There is no cost for this, and a targeted ICP Sample database will be provided to you after the call. 

Is the strategy call really free?

Yes. The initial strategy call is free and carries no obligation to work with MarketJoy.
